meta.name: Deadlock skins
meta.title: Deadlock Skins: Custom Hero Skin Mods | Deadlock Mod Manager
meta.description: Install custom Deadlock hero skins from GameBanana, preview them in 3D and switch back to the default look any time. Free, with the open-source Deadlock Mod Manager.

howToGet.question: How do I get skins in Deadlock?
howToGet.answer: Deadlock has no skin shop yet, so skins come from the modding community on GameBanana. Install Deadlock Mod Manager, filter the Mods Store by Skins and your hero, download a skin, then pick it in Hero Skins.

visibility.question: Can other players see my Deadlock skins?
visibility.answer: No. Skins are client-side. You see the new model, everyone else sees the default one.

free.question: Are Deadlock skins free?
free.answer: Yes. Community skins on GameBanana are free, and so is Deadlock Mod Manager.

revert.question: How do I go back to a hero's default skin?
revert.answer: Open Hero Skins, pick the hero and choose the default appearance. The skin stays downloaded, so you can switch back later.

multiple.question: Can I use more than one skin for the same hero?
multiple.answer: One skin is active per hero at a time, and the app warns you if two would clash. You can also give a hero several skins and get a random pick on every launch.

official.question: Will Deadlock have official skins?
official.answer: Valve hasn't released official cosmetics yet. If they arrive, community skins will still be available through the app.

hero.title: Custom skins for every Deadlock hero
hero.intro: Remodels, recolors and full overhauls made by the community. Deadlock Mod Manager groups them by hero, shows them in 3D and swaps them in a click.

popular.title: Popular hero skins
popular.intro: Community skins from the Mods Store. Each card opens the skin on GameBanana; install it from the app.
popular.snapshot: Snapshot from October 2026. Download counts come from GameBanana.

steps.title: How to install a Deadlock skin

install.title: Get Deadlock Mod Manager
install.body: Install it on Windows or Linux. It detects your game folder on its own.

filter.title: Filter by hero
filter.body: In the Mods Store, include the Skins category and the hero you play.

download.title: Download the skin
download.body: If the skin comes in several styles, pick the variant you want.

activate.title: Set it in Hero Skins
activate.body: Choose the active skin for that hero, check it in the 3D preview, then hit Launch modded.

foundry.title: Make your own skin
foundry.intro: The Mod Foundry loads a hero model from the base game or from a skin you own. Paint it, swap sounds, preview it in 3D and export a ready-to-install mod.
foundry.exports: Exports can be saved as a file, added to your library as a new mod, or replace the skin you started from (the original is kept as a backup). <link>Read the Mod Foundry guide</link>.

figure.alt: The Mod Foundry skin editor in Deadlock Mod Manager, showing a hero model with paint and sound tools
figure.caption: Mod Foundry: edit a hero skin and export it as a mod.

downloadBand.title: Give your hero a new look
downloadBand.body: Free and open source, for Windows and Linux. Skins are client-side, and the default model is always one click away.
